This is the errata version PC-E2 of [[Death Star: Central Core (Virtual Set 15)]] (version 3 of 3). The image here is the current Players Committee card image published 9 March 2026. This is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image that differs visibly from the one before is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026); the <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of one date are one publication.
* '''Original''' ([[Death Star: Central Core (Virtual Set 15)]]): Card image first published 22 June 2021<ref name="img-Playtest">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/death_star_central_core.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/7df3091df9d13149ec8100ab0d8c2b838567a2a7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/death_star_central_core.gif holotable commit 7df3091], 22 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/death_star_central_core.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd8bccdd1870eb7593e38093132a51fe2c4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/death_star_central_core.png holotable commit ee4c4cd], 22 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/30816d1eceffdd0a07a5af277fcbcbc9fc96f665/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png holotable commit 30816d1], 22 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/30816d1eceffdd0a07a5af277fcbcbc9fc96f665/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif holotable commit 30816d1], 22 June 2021) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>, the evening before the set's official release (23 June 2021), as a playtest upload: “Light: If A Power Loss 'shut down' this game, Force drain +1 here and Death Star Tractor Beam lost. Dark: If you occupy, opponent must first use 1 Force to move a character from here.” The card is stored upright (portrait: PNG 703×980; GIF 745×1039, holotable 7df3091); the same day the files were renamed (holotable 30816d1, “filename fixes”, same image). On release day the PC re-uploaded the card turned 90° to landscape, the way location cards are shown<ref name="img-Original">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9319460b36d9e7accecf0d32799fc84256802ef7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif holotable commit 9319460], 23 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9319460b36d9e7accecf0d32799fc84256802ef7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png holotable commit 9319460], 23 June 2021) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref> (holotable 9319460, “fixing rotation on v15”: PNG 980×703, GIF 745×534). Turned back, it is pixel-for-pixel the playtest upload, with the same words, so the two are one version (an image that only re-orients a printing is a note on that printing; Bill, 25 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Death Star: Central Core (Virtual Set 15) (Errata)]]): '''First published 20 April 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65 commit 2640d50]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Card image published 21 April 2022<ref name="img-PC-E1">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3f7288d580f892a638c6e3b78ca43474ade7756a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif holotable commit 3f7288d], 21 April 2022); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png holotable commit 2640d50], 20 April 2022) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: If A Power Loss 'shut down' this game, Force drain +1 here and Death Star Tractor Beam lost. Dark: If you occupy, opponent must first use 1 Force to move a character from here.” '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark; the words are the same as the previous version. '''What changed:''' The PC re-rendered the card from a new high-resolution master (holotable 2640d50, “Set 18 and errata”, 20 April 2022: PNG now 1039×745; the GIF copy, holotable 3f7288d, 21 April 2022, stays 745×534), so art, frame, icons and text all render slightly differently. Most visibly: the line down the right border “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” became “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” in small capitals. Words unchanged. This image was first published on 20 April 2022 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65 commit 2640d50]); the card-size GIF uploaded 11 June 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c commit 6894629], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E2) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Card image published 9 March 2026 (current; the image the PC card data uses)<ref name="img-PC-E3">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif holotable commit 6f23e07], 9 March 2026); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e02f932ae2c407c7c4f2e22fe565a8a64afd742b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png holotable commit e02f932], 7 March 2026) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: While opponent occupies, you may not play Blast The Door, Kid! during battles on Death Star. Dark: While Obi-Wan here, total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' Light Side text “If A Power Loss 'shut down' this game, Force drain +1 here and Death Star Tractor Beam lost.” became “While opponent occupies, you may not play Blast The Door, Kid! during battles on Death Star.” Dark Side text “If you occupy, opponent must first use 1 Force to move a character from here.” became “While Obi-Wan here, total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.” The image now prints the errata mark “E1” (holotable e02f932, “LS Errata”, PNG, 7 March 2026; GIF 6f23e07, 9 March 2026).
}}
